name: Create Keyless SSL Configuration
description: Create Keyless SSL Configuration Creates a Keyless SSL configuration that allows SSL/TLS termination without exposing private keys to Cloudflare. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/keyless_certificates
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/keyless_certificates
Creates a Keyless SSL configuration that allows SSL/TLS termination without exposing private keys to Cloudflare. Keys remain on your infrastructure.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete Keyless SSL Configuration

name: Edit Keyless SSL Configuration
description: Edit Keyless SSL Configuration This will update attributes of a Keyless SSL. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/keyless_certificates/{keyless_certificate_id}

name: Get Keyless SSL Configuration
description: Get Keyless SSL Configuration Get details for one Keyless SSL configuration. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/keyless_certificates/{keyless_certificate_id}

name: List Keyless SSL Configurations
description: List Keyless SSL Configurations List all Keyless SSL configurations for a given zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/keyless_certificates
context:
